meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以查看当前允许智能体访问的文件夹,添加新文件夹或移除已有文件夹,并为每个文件夹设置只读或可读写权限。
howto.when: 当你说“mounts”、“mount allowlist”、“container mounts”等关键词,或要求查看/添加/移除智能体能访问的目录时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看当前允许智能体访问哪些目录
say.note: 会显示目录列表及权限。

say.text: 把 /data 加进允许列表,设为只读
say.note: 会检查路径并更新配置。

say.text: 移除 /tmp 这个允许访问的目录
say.note: 会先展示当前配置再确认移除。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can view the host directories agents are allowed to access, add or remove directories, and set each to read-only or read-write.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "mounts", "mount allowlist", "container mounts", or ask to view/add/remove directories agents can access.

say_en.text: Show me which directories agents can currently access.
Add /data to the allowlist as read-only.
say_en.note: Validates the path and updates the config.

say_en.text: Remove /tmp from the allowed mount list.
say_en.note: Shows current config then confirms removal.
